fatal_errors: The proposed copper system is unrelated to the target NbMoTaW and NbMoTaWRe refractory high-entropy-alloy films.
It replaces Re alloying and helium implantation with an unsupported cold-rolling and annealing intervention.
It does not address irradiation-induced hardening, helium-bubble segregation, or grain-boundary embrittlement.
The claimed 20% elongation improvement and FCC-wide applicability have no cited evidence or specified processing parameters.
explanation: The hypothesis addresses ductility only in a generic sense and does not reconstruct the target material, intervention, irradiation conditions, mechanism, baseline, or outcomes. Its tensile-testing/EBSD proposal is somewhat falsifiable, but the processing schedule is undefined and the numerical thresholds are arbitrary. No supporting evidence is supplied. The target instead supports Re-containing sputtered NbMoTaWRe films as more resistant to room-temperature helium-irradiation-induced hardening and grain-boundary embrittlement because their refined, distorted microstructure and amorphous boundary regions act as defect sinks.
